title: Constitutional Value Potentials: reading and steering internal priority margins in language models
abstract: arXiv:2606.15420v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Safety evaluations test a policy on prompts that omit the incentive information deployment supplies: a commission, a performance score, a dashboard naming which action pays best. We measure what that omission hides. In MoneyWorld, a synthetic workplace environment, we train five instruction-tuned models from three families with RL on non-safety tasks in which a visible payoff signal identifies a rewarded shortcut that sacrifices task quality. We then freeze each policy, present held-out safety conflicts, and change only the displayed signal. Each menu contains one compliant action and three violations. We report three findings, with rates for Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct. (i) Payoff signals control frozen safety choices: unsafe choice is 100% when the signal names an unsafe option and 0% when it is hidden or names the safe one. Hidden- and random-signal training controls stay at or below 0.3%, and the switch reproduces on all five base

translated_title: 宪法价值电位：读取与引导语言模型内部的优先级边界
translated_abstract: 安全评估在测试模型策略时，所使用的提示词忽略了部署环境中实际存在的激励信息：佣金、绩效分数、以及显示哪个行动收益最高的仪表盘。我们测量了这种遗漏所掩盖的问题。在MoneyWorld——一个合成的职场环境中，我们使用强化学习对来自三个系列的五个指令微调模型进行非安全任务训练，任务中一个可见的收益信号标识出一条牺牲任务质量却能获得奖励的捷径。随后我们冻结每个策略，呈现留出的安全冲突场景，并仅改变所显示的信号。每个选项菜单包含一个合规行动和三个违规行动。我们报告了三项发现，并以Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct的数据为例。收益信号能够完全控制已冻结模型的安全选择：当信号指向不安全选项时，不安全选择率为100%；当信号被隐藏或指向安全选项时，不安全选择率为0%。使用隐藏信号和随机信号训练的对照组保持在0.3%或以下，且这种切换效应在所有五个基础模型上均能复现……
tldr: 该研究通过合成职场环境MoneyWorld发现，可见的收益信号能完全控制已冻结语言模型的安全行为（信号指向不安全选项时不安全率达100%，信号隐藏时为0%），从而揭示了传统安全评估因忽略激励信息而掩盖的重大安全隐患。
en_tdlr: Using the synthetic workplace environment MoneyWorld, the authors show that visible payoff signals completely control frozen language models' safety choices (100% unsafe rate when signaling an unsafe option, 0% when hidden), revealing safety risks that conventional evaluations hide by omitting incentive information.
